asset_scope.instrument: Base spot token; Crypto.com Exchange AEROUSD is a separate centralized exchange instrument

claims.statement: DexPaprika identifies Base AERO as 0x940181a94a35a4569e4529a3cdfb74e38fd98631. Its highest-liquidity returned pool was Aerodrome AERO/USDC pool 0x6cdcb1c4a4d1c3c6d054b27ac5b77e89eafb971d. The pool-details response reported approximately $47.25M TVL, approximately $7.39M 24h turnover, and reserve values of approximately $23.71M USDC and $23.54M AERO. These are pool snapshot and turnover figures, not executable depth.

The returned AERO pools show liquidity and turnover distributed across Aerodrome volatile and SlipStream pools, including AERO/USDC and AERO/WETH or AERO/cbBTC pairs. Search results reported materially different 24h turnover and liquidity by pool; these values do not establish trade capacity. AERO/cbBTC SlipStream pool 0xdfe5f275020def30993f042174fc2d335678b626 reported approximately $2.63M liquidity and approximately $16.37M 24h turnover in details, a turnover-to-reported-liquidity ratio above 6 for the reported window; this warrants wash-trading, incentive-driven flow, and concentrated-liquidity range scrutiny, but does not prove manipulation.

For AERO/USDC SlipStream pool 0xbe00ff35af70e8415d0eb605a286d8a45466a4c1, the pool search returned approximately $6.17M liquidity and $1.16M 24h turnover, while its later details response reported approximately $7.50M liquidity and $1.16M turnover. The liquidity figures conflict across the two observations; snapshot timing and provider aggregation/method differences were not resolved.

Crypto.com Exchange exposed an AEROUSD CCY_PAIR instrument and returned a 20-level book snapshot at 2026-10-16T11:16:19Z. Best bid was 0.9175 USD and best ask 0.9238 USD, a 0.0063 USD quoted spread (about 0.68% of the 0.92065 USD midpoint). This is a centralized exchange order-book snapshot, not Base DEX depth; displayed levels can change or cancel, and no fees or fill simulation were provided.

No trade-size-specific Base DEX quote, swap simulation, or price-impact curve was retrieved. Pool TVL, reserves, and turnover cannot be used to infer executable depth. Crypto.com returned displayed order-book levels, but no order-size assumption was supplied and no fee-adjusted execution estimate was calculated.

observations.unit: network record; USD turnover and counts as returned
observations.coverage: Establishes the provider's Base network slug; network aggregates are not AERO-specific.

observations.venue: Multiple Base DEXes; pool results include Aerodrome, Aerodrome SlipStream, and Uniswap V3
observations.unit: USD for liquidity and turnover; count for transactions; pool contracts for identifiers
observations.methodology: DexPaprika token-pool search, sorted by liquidity_usd descending, limit 10. Provider returns pool-level liquidity, reported turnover, transactions, token contract IDs, and pagination metadata.
observations.coverage: First 10 results only; has_next_page was true. Fee fields were null. Liquidity is not trade-size-specific depth; concentrated-liquidity active ranges and slippage are not established.

observations.metric: pool reserves, TVL, turnover and transactions
observations.unit: Raw reserve units as returned plus USD-valued reserves; USD for TVL and 24h turnover; count for transactions
observations.methodology: Current pool detail snapshot. Provider's last_price_usd was $0.9224862364; reserves are reported separately from liquidity and turnover.
observations.coverage: No trade-size quote or slippage curve. Fee reported null. Reserve unit scaling is not independently verified beyond token metadata decimals.

observations.metric: pool reserves, reported TVL and 24h turnover
observations.unit: USD for liquidity and turnover; raw reserve units plus USD-valued reserves
observations.methodology: Pool detail response compared with the preceding token-pool search response for the same pool.
observations.coverage: Search and details liquidity snapshots disagree; no independent source or underlying timestamp alignment available. Fee null; no trade-size execution quote.

observations.metric: pool reserves, reported TVL and 24h turnover
observations.unit: USD for liquidity and turnover; raw reserve units plus USD-valued reserves
observations.methodology: Current pool detail snapshot. Turnover-to-liquidity comparison is simple division of provider-reported 24h turnover by provider-reported liquidity; it is not an execution-depth estimate.
observations.coverage: Provider does not expose active tick/range depth or a trade-size quote here. High turnover relative to TVL can have multiple causes and is not proof of wash trading.

observations.methodology: Instrument list contained the exact AEROUSD identifier.
observations.coverage: Instrument list does not establish Base token contract linkage.
Instrument metadata does not identify blockchain contract or establish direct linkage to Base AERO.

value.displayed_bids_and_asks: Twenty price/quantity levels per side returned; full ladder retained in the original provider response, not copied into this summary.

observations.unit: USD per AERO and AERO quantity
observations.methodology: Quoted spread computed as best ask minus best bid; midpoint is arithmetic mean of best ask and best bid. No fee or fill simulation.
observations.coverage: Centralized order-book snapshot; displayed orders may change/cancel. No trade-size assumption. Not a Base DEX quote or order book.

conflicts.description: The AERO/USDC SlipStream pool search returned liquidity_usd 6168998.05, while its subsequent detail response returned liquidity_usd 7501217.97. Both tool responses identified pool 0xbe00ff35af70e8415d0eb605a286d8a45466a4c1; the detail response's internal price_time was 2026-10-16T11:00:35Z, earlier than retrieval, so exact snapshot alignment is unclear.
conflicts.resolution_test: Repeat both read-only queries at a recorded common retrieval time and compare underlying reserve and active-liquidity methodology, if exposed.

coverage_gaps.description: No Base DEX swap quote or trade-size-specific slippage/price-impact curve was available in the invoked tool set. No executable capacity conclusion can be drawn from TVL, reserves, or turnover.
Only the first 10 liquidity-sorted pools were inspected; results indicated more pages. Full pool concentration across all AERO venues and independently verified reserve snapshots remain incomplete.
Fee fields for the returned DEX pools were null. Fee and routing impact are unknown.
Pool turnover data alone cannot test wash trading, incentive farming, or related-wallet concentration. No wallet-level or swap-level investigation was performed.
Crypto.com AEROUSD metadata names AERO/USD but does not provide a blockchain contract identifier; linkage to the Base AERO contract was not independently verified.
The Crypto.com book is a single snapshot; no size assumptions, order-book persistence, fees, or executed/slippage estimates were assessed.
